topics.title: Big-O Notation
topics.task: Constant Time O(1): Read an integer N from the console. Regardless of how large N is, just print the number multiplied by 10 to demonstrate a single, constant mathematical operation.

topics.title: Time Complexity Classes
topics.task: Linear Time O(n): Read an integer N. Then read a line containing N space-separated integers. Iterate through them and print their total sum.

topics.title: Space Complexity
topics.task: Read a string from the console. Output the exact length (number of characters) of the string.
